evals.name: owner-versus-label
evals.prompt: A shipment has a tracking GUID and mutable caption. Define their C# types for an event-backed command.
evals.expected_output: Separate history key and ordinary scalar.
assertions: The command carries the supplied tracking ID rather than creating a key in Handle.

evals.name: wire-regression
evals.prompt: The client receives an object where it expects a currency code string. Specify a regression check.
assertions: Asserts a scalar JSON string rather than a Value property.
Deserializes the same bytes and compares with the original concept.

evals.name: wrong-history
evals.prompt: A handler returns the correct event but balances never change for the selected account. Test whether the account key routes correctly.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch and assert exact output on chosen source.
assertions: Uses a known account ID on the command.
Checks the scenario append on that ID, not only the returned object.
